name: Gauntlets of Whirling Strikes

attunement.text: by a creature with at least 1 level in Monk

entries: Crafted from dark leather reinforced with steel studs, these gauntlets radiate kinetic energy. They sharpen a monk's timing and precision.
Whirling Fury (1/day). When you hit a single target with multiple consecutive attacks, each hit deals +1 additional damage of the same type. This bonus resets if you miss or switch targets.
Evasive Maneuver (1/day). As a bonus action, grant yourself and all allies within 10 feet a +1 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws for 1 minute.
